# Numerics-Provenance Checklist: SSH-XXZ Experiments 01–04

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review (numerics + provenance) as PR gate before tasks
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [research.md](../research.md), [data-model.md](../data-model.md), [contracts/](../contracts/), [quickstart.md](../quickstart.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Scope: 01–04 only; 05/hardware excluded. Every item tests the requirements
themselves (completeness/clarity/consistency/measurability/coverage), never
implementation behavior.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK002 - Is the gap-curve 49-point reuse (R1) recorded as binding, including the definition of "complete" as 49 points × 4 sizes? [Completeness, Spec §AS-01.2/Edge; Plan §R1]
- [x] CHK003 - Is the decided q-grid (q_n array, π explicit, saved per record) promoted into a binding requirements document, or does it live only in research? [Completeness, Plan §R2; Gap]
- [x] CHK004 - Is the fixed n_restarts=3 value recorded in a binding document rather than only in the research rationale? [Completeness, Plan §R4; Gap]
- [x] CHK005 - Are schema exp01-04/v1 field lists complete for all five entities including provenance and failure blocks? [Completeness, Plan §data-model]
- [x] CHK006 - Are diagnostic and PRA pipeline requirements both documented with distinct acceptance conditions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010; Plan §quickstart]
